data.title: Capital One
data.about:
Introducing Capital One at Motor City Dubai, the first-ever Grade A offices for sale in Dubai’s iconic motorsport-inspired community. These groundbreaking Motor City Dubai commercial properties redefines workspace excellence. 

Developed by Centuria, the project boasts 19 floors of premium office spaces purpose-built with full floor available from AED 31M. Designed with precision and sophistication, the offices offer state-of-the-art facilities, advanced security systems, and ample parking, ensuring a seamless and efficient working environment for enterprises of all sizes.

Situated in the heart of Motor City, this prestigious development offers unparalleled connectivity with easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, linking it to major business districts and residential neighborhoods. Capital One at Motor City Dubai creates an ideal setting for businesses seeking to thrive in a well-connected and vibrant environment. Whether you're an entrepreneur, a growing business, or a corporate entity, this exceptional destination provides the perfect blend of functionality, innovation, and prestige.

characteristics_module.title: Capital One at Motor City: Accelerate Your Growth in a Thriving Motorsport-Inspired Hub!
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• First Grade A Offices in Motor City: Capital One offices for sale set a new benchmark for commercial properties in Dubai's motorsport-inspired community.
  • Strategic Location: Conveniently located with easy access to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, providing excellent connectivity to key business hubs and residential neighborhoods.
  • Ample Space for Growth: Full floors of these commercial offices by Centuria in Dubai span 17,500 sq. ft., designed to accommodate diverse business needs with flexible layouts.
  • State-of-the-Art Facilities: Equipped with advanced security systems, modern infrastructure, and purpose-built designs for maximum efficiency.
  • Developer Credibility Delivered by Centuria, known for creating iconic and innovative commercial real estate properties in the UAE.
  • Convenience & Accessibility: Includes ample parking spaces and seamless access to major transportation routes,ensuring convenience for employees and visitors alike.
  • Modern Design & Functionality: Premium finishes and thoughtfully designed workspaces cater to businesses seeking a contemporary and productive environment.

location_tile.title: What Makes Motor City the Ideal Location for Offices?
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Motor City is one of Dubai’s most dynamic and strategically located communities, offering a unique motorsport-inspired vibe paired with unmatched accessibility and convenience. Positioned along Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, this thriving area ensures seamless connectivity to Dubai’s major business districts, residential neighborhoods, and key landmarks, making it an exceptional choice for commercial real estate.

With the introduction of premium offices for sale in Dubai, Motor City has emerged as a top contender for companies seeking modern, Grade A office spaces that combine functionality, accessibility, and an inspiring atmosphere.

  • Downtown Dubai - 17 Minutes
  • Dubai Marina - 17 Minutes
  • Dubai International Financial Centre (DIFC) - 20 Minutes
  • Dubai International Airport - 24 Minutes
  • Jebel Ali - 28 Minutes
